Author: jeffrick-cloud
Name: XivCinema
Description: Play video with your party in sync, on a floating window or a screen placed in the game world. The host provides the video; viewers just install the plugin and click Join.
Punchline: The player for players: synced watch parties on a 2D window or a 3D screen in the world.
Changelog: 0.1.4: Fixes watch parties looping when the host's video buffers (YouTube start-up or a network hiccup): viewers now wait for the host and resume with it. Everyone should update. In-frame rendering (experimental, off by default) reworked.
